spell.name: Life Sap
entries: You target a creature within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and you do not regain hit points.
The spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the necrotic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.
